breadth_decision.decision: DEPTH headline (horizon: longer traces, late-window coverage of the frozen v0.17.0 sequential-margin region) plus a reported BREADTH block (per-bit partial certificates).
reasons: v0.17.0 GNB failed on usefulness only (c, d): RGNB4 was sound (0 false in 240, CP95 0.0124) but C at eps 0.02 was 0.052 [0.041, 0.065] and dC over RGN4 was +0.0017 [-0.0005, +0.0041] (Observed, GATES_019).

The sequential boundary grows like eps_bar*b + O(sqrt(b)) while a wrong hypothesis gathers mismatches at a rate set by its distance from the truth; on 28-step traces the two are not yet separated (Inferred). Longer traces test this without changing the region.
The oracle RGN4_or reached C 0.339 at eps 0.02 with 0 false (Observed), so there is coverage to recover.
Per-bit certificates are a cheap breadth extension that keeps the same conditional soundness argument (Inferred).
